entities.name: Elyssendril Lademmdrith
entities.description: An elven priestess from Argoth in the time of the Thran, kidnapped by Yawgmoth and later a delegate to Halcyon.

entities.name: Argoth
entities.description: Home of the elves of Elyssendril, afflicted by the Creeping Mold.

entities.name: Yawgmoth
entities.description: Exiled Thran who turned the Creeping Mold into a plague, kidnapped Elyssendril and punished her on Phyrexia.

entities.name: Creeping Mold of Argoth
entities.description: A mold Yawgmoth turned into a virulent plague that ate away the elves.

entities.name: Halcyon
entities.description: Site of a meeting of delegates against Yawgmoth.

entities.name: Thran Alliance
entities.description: Alliance that sent delegates to Halcyon against Yawgmoth.

entities.name: Phyrexia
entities.description: Place where Yawgmoth took Elyssendril to its fourth sphere.

entities.name: Daelic elves
entities.description: Elves Elyssendril was said to belong to.

entities.name: Thran
entities.description: The people of the era in which Elyssendril lived.

events.summary: Yawgmoth turns the Creeping Mold of Argoth into a plague that eats away the elves.
events.quote: Yawgmoth turned the Creeping Mold of Argoth into a virulent plague

events.summary: Yawgmoth kidnaps Elyssendril and her healers and ransoms them.
events.quote: He also kidnapped Elyssendril Lademmdrith and her healers

events.summary: The elves pay the ransom and receive only sweetened water and twelve dead healers.
events.quote: he delivered to them only sweetened water and 12 dead healers

events.summary: Elyssendril is sent to Halcyon as a delegate for the Thran Alliance against Yawgmoth.
events.quote: later part of the delegates sent to Halcyon

events.summary: Yawgmoth punishes her by putting her in a vat on Phyrexia's fourth sphere, with fingers growing from her forehead.
events.quote: Yawgmoth brought her to the fourth sphere of Phyrexia where she was put into a vat

relations.quote: As punishment for her speaking out against him
she was of the Daelic elves
